01 / Operating System

Why ADHD is actually an unfair engineering advantage.

(Provided you ignore my sleep schedule and the 14 unfinished side-quests in my ~/projects directory.)

RULE 01 // BOREDOM ALLERGY

If it's manual, it's a bug.

Copy-pasting B2B leads into a spreadsheet? Absolutely not. My dopamine receptors would rather resign. So I build async Python scrapers + self-hosted n8n pipelines that run while I'm asleep.

RULE 02 // 2 AM ARCHITECTURE

Zero bloat, terminal first.

Why pay $99/month for bloated SaaS when a raw Debian VM on Google Cloud, DuckDNS, and 120 lines of clean FastAPI do the exact same job with 18ms latency?

RULE 03 // RABBIT HOLES

Shipped > Theoretical.

When I get curious about WebSockets, mountain drone logistics, or quantitative trading alphas, I don't just watch a tutorial—I build a working prototype before the hyperfixation wears off.
